Industrial Magnate.name: Industrial Magnate
Industrial Magnate.description: You oversee the massive, grinding factories of Bren, leveraging wealth and authority to keep the artifact-fueled engines turning.

High Society Broker.name: High Society Broker
High Society Broker.description: You navigate the treacherous ballrooms and salons of the elite, trading in whispers, favors, and lucrative alliances.

Artifact Speculator.name: Artifact Speculator
Artifact Speculator.description: You fund the expeditions and take the financial risks, gambling your fortune on the unearthing of the next great pre-fall machine.

Underworld Patron.name: Underworld Patron
Underworld Patron.description: You are the velvet glove over a rusted iron fist, quietly funding the city's criminal element to execute your unsavory errands.

Guild Sponsor.name: Guild Sponsor
Guild Sponsor.description: You hold the purse strings for the gruff explorers braving the jungle, managing their contracts and reaping the glory of their discoveries.

Scandal Deflector.name: Scandal Deflector
Scandal Deflector.description: You are a master of public relations, making the lethal malfunctions of aristocratic vanity projects quietly disappear from the public eye.

Arcane Investor.name: Arcane Investor
Arcane Investor.description: You pour your immense wealth into the laboratories of the Wizards, securing exclusive rights to the latest magical circuitry and experimental tech.

Wasteland Survivor.name: Wasteland Survivor
Wasteland Survivor.description: You have survived the brutal elements beyond the city walls longer than most, hardened by starvation, thirst, and the unforgiving jungle.

Monster Hunter.name: Monster Hunter
Monster Hunter.description: You specialize in tracking and slaughtering the nightmarish aberrations that stalk the ruins, knowing precisely where to strike for the kill.

Ruin Delver.name: Ruin Delver
Ruin Delver.description: You treat collapsed temples and buried facilities as puzzles, expertly navigating ancient architecture and disarming lethal traps.

Myth Seeker.name: Myth Seeker
Myth Seeker.description: You chase the campfire stories and forbidden legends of the wastes, guided by an intuition for where the greatest artifacts lie hidden.

Wasteland Ward.name: Wasteland Ward
Wasteland Ward.description: You act as a living oasis for your expedition, projecting the city's divine influence to ward your allies against the blistering heat and the brutal hazards of the sands.

Dune Tracker.name: Dune Tracker
Dune Tracker.description: You can find a trail in the middle of a blinding sandstorm, using the harsh winds of Bren's arid wastes to mask your movements.

Brute Beast Hunter.name: Brute Beast Hunter
Brute Beast Hunter.description: You bring down the desert's most resilient monstrosities, relying on overwhelming force and brutish tactics to physically shatter their natural defenses.

Circle Hierophant.name: Circle Hierophant
Circle Hierophant.description: You sit at the upper echelons of the faith, commanding the masses and safeguarding the deepest, most dangerous secrets of the city's plane-formation.

Maintenance Priest.name: Maintenance Priest
Maintenance Priest.description: You view the city's massive engines as holy relics, blending religious devotion with the greasy, hands-on work of keeping the gears turning.

Inquisitor of the Circle.name: Inquisitor of the Circle
Inquisitor of the Circle.description: You are the terrifying hand of the church, rooting out heresy, unauthorized magic, and those who ask too many questions.

Mass Celebrant.name: Mass Celebrant
Mass Celebrant.description: You are the charismatic voice of the faith, leading the congregations in grand rituals and keeping the populace pacified and devout.

Temple Scholar.name: Temple Scholar
Temple Scholar.description: You dwell in the dust of the holy libraries, piecing together the true history of Bren and the sacred blueprints of its architecture.

Omen Reader.name: Omen Reader
Omen Reader.description: You study the subtle shifts in arcane energy and natural phenomena, predicting disasters and divine will through artifacts and the weather.

Moral Arbiter.name: Moral Arbiter
Moral Arbiter.description: You are the judge of spiritual purity in the city, using theological debate and strict law to steer the populace away from forbidden temptations.

Underbelly Stowaway.name: Underbelly Stowaway
Underbelly Stowaway.description: You are a ghost in the city's slums, surviving in the forgotten cracks of Bren by staying unseen and scavenging what the rich throw away.

Corporate Saboteur.name: Corporate Saboteur
Corporate Saboteur.description: You are paid to cripple rival industries, slipping into heavily guarded factories to sever arcane circuits and jam the gears.

Cat Burglar.name: Cat Burglar
Cat Burglar.description: You scale the sheer walls of aristocratic estates, bypassing locks and security measures to steal priceless artifacts from under their noses.

Chameleon Infiltrator.name: Chameleon Infiltrator
Chameleon Infiltrator.description: You are a master of disguise and social blending, able to walk into a high-society gala or a dockside tavern and belong perfectly.

Arcane Disruptor.name: Arcane Disruptor
Arcane Disruptor.description: You understand just enough magic to break it, short-circuiting magical locks and overloading defensive runes with a flick of the wrist.

Shadow Courier.name: Shadow Courier
Shadow Courier.description: You move illicit goods across the city's rooftops and sewers, relying on speed and absolute silence to avoid the guard patrols.

Alleyway Informant.name: Alleyway Informant
Alleyway Informant.description: You are the eyes and ears of the streets, trading secrets, reading people, and knowing exactly who to talk to when trouble brews.

Contract Thief.name: Contract Thief
Contract Thief.description: You are a professional acquirer of things, meticulously planning heists to lift specific, highly guarded artifacts for wealthy clients.

Beat Cop.name: Beat Cop
Beat Cop.description: You walk the grimy streets of the lower tiers, relying on your fists, your commanding presence, and your knowledge of the local gangs to keep order.

Precinct Investigator.name: Precinct Investigator
Precinct Investigator.description: You piece together the aftermath of the city's crimes, tracking suspects, scrying through forged documents, and finding the truth.

Heavy Enforcer.name: Heavy Enforcer
Heavy Enforcer.description: You are the blunt instrument of the law, heavily armored and armed with crushing weapons to break up riots and smash resistance.

Gate Watchman.name: Gate Watchman
Gate Watchman.description: You stand between the safety of Bren and the horrors of the jungle, trained to spot smugglers, monsters, and trouble from a mile away.

Circle Swordsman.name: Circle Swordsman
Circle Swordsman.description: You are an elite, highly trained duelist for the city, using disciplined martial tactics to disarm and dismantle your opponents.

Riot Suppressor.name: Riot Suppressor
Riot Suppressor.description: You hold the line when the commonry boils over, trained in crowd control, physical endurance, and the psychological tactics of mass intimidation.

Military General.name: Military General
Military General.description: You orchestrate the macro-defenses of the city, navigating aristocratic politics while commanding the tactical deployment of troops.

Master Mason.name: Master Mason
Master Mason.description: You built the walls that keep the jungle out, possessing an intimate understanding of structural integrity and the sheer strength to shape stone.

Circle Farmer.name: Circle Farmer
Circle Farmer.description: You coax life from the toxic, dry soil of the city's outskirts, surviving the grueling elements to feed the masses.

Street Alchemist.name: Street Alchemist
Street Alchemist.description: You brew volatile mixtures in makeshift labs, creating cheap medicines, chemical explosives, and chemical solutions for everyday problems.

Factory Hand.name: Factory Hand
Factory Hand.description: You have survived years in the deafening, toxic belly of Bren's industrial sector, learning how to keep the rusted machines from exploding.

Caravan Driver.name: Caravan Driver
Caravan Driver.description: You haul goods across the treacherous roads of the city and its immediate borders, skilled in rapid repairs and evasive driving.

Market Trader.name: Market Trader
Market Trader.description: You run the bustling bazaars, haggling over scraps and reading the intentions of desperate buyers and shady suppliers alike.

Tough Laborer.name: Tough Laborer
Tough Laborer.description: You are the backbone of the city's physical expansion, relying on raw strength, calloused hands, and a high tolerance for pain.

Circuit Engineer.name: Circuit Engineer
Circuit Engineer.description: You design the magical pathways that power Bren's revolution, merging arcane theory with the practical reality of copper and wire.

Artifact Researcher.name: Artifact Researcher
Artifact Researcher.description: You push your mind to the brink of madness trying to understand the terrifying relics pulled from the ruins, uncovering their true nature.

Containment Specialist.name: Containment Specialist
Containment Specialist.description: You are called when an artifact wakes up, using dampening fields and arcane wards to prevent catastrophic magical meltdowns.

Arcane Inventor.name: Arcane Inventor
Arcane Inventor.description: You tinker at the bleeding edge of science and magic, creating prototype tools and experimental mixtures that defy natural law.

Industrial Technomancer.name: Industrial Technomancer
Industrial Technomancer.description: You interface directly with the city's largest, most dangerous engines, keeping the volatile mix of steam and magic stable.

Wasteland Scholar.name: Wasteland Scholar
Wasteland Scholar.description: You document the esoteric lore of the jungle and its ruins, bridging the gap between high academia and the gritty reality of the explorers.

Rogue Arcanist.name: Rogue Arcanist
Rogue Arcanist.description: You operate outside the sanctioned labs, conducting highly illegal, dangerous experiments with artifacts that the Aristocracy deems too volatile.

Scrap-Waste Heretic.name: Scrap-Waste Heretic
Scrap-Waste Heretic.description: You are a feral outcast of the wastes, surviving the toxic sands by forming sacred, heretical bonds with the desert's mechanical beasts and the dark entities that command them.

Hair-Trigger Senses.name: Hair-Trigger Senses
Hair-Trigger Senses.description: The wastes do not forgive the blind or the deaf. Your senses have been sharpened to a razor's edge, giving you the twitch-reflexes needed to survive the unseen horrors of the desert.

Sword Fighter.name: Sword Fighter
Sword Fighter.description: You are a blur of steel in the wastes, keeping your eyes locked on your opponent to sidestep their strikes and punish their slightest mistakes.

Hammer Figher.name: Hammer Figher
Hammer Figher.description: You are a walking engine of blunt force, built to shrug off punishing blows while you crush armor, bone, and morale under the massive weight of your hammer.

Arcane Bombardier.name: Arcane Bombardier
Arcane Bombardier.description: Subtlety is a luxury you discarded for raw, explosive power. You can read the invisible currents of arcane energy and reduce heavily armored targets to smoking craters from a distance.

Natural Charmer.name: Natural Charmer
Natural Charmer.description: You have an uncanny ability to read a room and tell people exactly what they want to hear, defusing tension or swindling fools with a disarming smile.

Iron-Willed.name: Iron-Willed
Iron-Willed.description: You simply refuse to yield. Whether facing psychic intrusion, unbearable pain, or someone trying to manipulate you, your mind is an absolute fortress.

Calloused Survivor.name: Calloused Survivor
Calloused Survivor.description: You have been beaten, broken, and burned so many times that pain has just become another background noise you can easily ignore.

Contortionist.name: Contortionist
Contortionist.description: You possess an uncanny, almost unnatural flexibility, allowing you to slip out of grapples, squeeze into rusted ventilation shafts, and maintain perfect footing.

Heavyweight.name: Heavyweight
Heavyweight.description: You are built like a brick wall. Your sheer mass makes you incredibly difficult to move, and when you put your weight into something, it breaks.

Fate-Touched.name: Fate-Touched
Fate-Touched.description: You shouldn't be alive, yet things always seem to inexplicably work out in your favor right before disaster strikes.

Lore Savant.name: Lore Savant
Lore Savant.description: Once you see a schematic or read an ancient text, it is permanently burned into your mind, making you a walking encyclopedia of the old world.

Jury-Rigger.name: Jury-Rigger
Jury-Rigger.description: You can look at a pile of rusted trash and see a solution. You have an innate knack for cobbling together temporary fixes from completely unrelated parts.
